faculty_override_note: Only one official degree map is published for this certificate (no alternate five-semester map). DegreeWorks and CIS Department advisement remain authoritative.
sequence_notes: This is a fixed, fully-prescribed 10-course certificate: every course is individually required and there are no elective choice groups.

CIS 165 or CSC 110 or CSC 111 is required (or departmental approval, not encoded) before CIS 345, CIS 359, CIS 440, CIS 316, and CIS 362; encoded identically for all five as `CIS 165 or CSC 110 or CSC 111`. CSC 110 and CSC 111 are not part of this certificate's own course list -- they are external prerequisites that exist in the Computer Information Systems A.A.S. curriculum (cis_courses.csv).
CIS 345 and CIS 440 -> CIS 459 is machine-enforced.
"Or Departmental approval" alternates on every footnote are not course-based and are not encoded, matching the established practice for similar non-course alternates elsewhere in this repo.

CIS 459's official course-listing title is 'Ethical Hacking and System Defense', matching this degree map. The Computer Information Systems A.A.S. curriculum (cis_courses.csv) currently lists CIS 459 under a different title ('Security Penetration Testing') and without the CIS 165/CSC 110/CSC 111 prerequisite applied to CIS 359, CIS 362, and CIS 316 that this program's own map states -- flagged for maintainer review as a possible staleness in that other file, not something corrected here.
